context: Abstracted from private defense repo (MDSI). Generic patterns for high-reliability systems.

patterns.summary: 3-tier autonomous scaling (edge → sector → strategic) with per-tier autonomy modes.
SHA-256 hash-chain audit ledger — every event links to previous hash.
High-risk actions require 2 independent cryptographic signatures + different actors.
Full operation in Disconnected/Intermittent/Limited-bandwidth mode via peer gossip.
4th-order Runge-Kutta integration + Proportional Navigation guidance law.
Radar detection range vs jammer power (J/S ratio).
Multi-source entity-link graph with BFS cluster discovery.
Dynamic asset-to-objective pairing by effective Pk + time-to-intercept.
